citation: Tremor peak 7-11 Hz in 90% of 237 subjects (Lakie 1994; open-access summary in PMC4594250); secondary 20-25 Hz tremor component: Vaillancourt & Newell 2000. The low-frequency sway/breathing tone is a design assumption.
notes: Wide-FOV consumer optics (~1 mrad/px): roll and keystone are visibly significant here.
